title_original: 수표법 적용 시 은행과 동일시되는 사람 또는 시설의 지정에 관한 규정
full_text:
Addendum to the Enforcement Decree of the Fisheries Cooperatives Act <Presidential Decree No. 27556, October 25, 2016>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on December 1, 2016.
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) through (15) Omitted.
(16) Part of the Regulations on Designation of Persons or Institutions Deemed Equivalent to Banks for Purposes of Applying the Check Act shall be amended as follows:
Subparagraph 6 shall be deleted.
(17) through (23) Omitted.
